turns.query: How many distinct 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION' sensitive areas have their polygon centroid within 3000 metres of at least one GENERAL-type air-quality station? Count each institution once. Return the count.
turns.actual_response: There are 883 distinct healthcare institutions whose polygon centroid is within 3000 metres of at least one GENERAL-type air quality station.
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as health_general_3km
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM air_quality_station aqs
    WHERE aqs.station_type = 'GENERAL'
    AND ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography
    ) <= 3000
)
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
health_general_3km = int(result['health_general_3km'].values[0])
